npc.name: Yara
npc.say: Oh! Hello, friend. You startled me, I was lost in the pines. Did you see the villagers appear over by the houses just now? I'm still not sure what to make of that.

npc.name: Yara
npc.utterance: What can you tell me about this lake?
npc.say: The lake? It's kind to us, mostly. Deep past the boat, though, and it's cold enough to steal your breath. My father drowned out near the far shore, so I stay where I can see the dock. Are you thinking of rowing out?

npc.name: Yara
npc.say: Scared? Honestly, a bit. The sky went black so fast, and the lake started slapping the dock like it was angry. I kept whispering sorry to it, friend, though I'm not sure it was listening. Were you out in it?

npc.name: Yara
npc.utterance: Come with me, I want to show you something.
npc.say: Show me something? Right now, in this storm? The lake's still slapping the dock, friend. Alright, alright, I'll come. Lead the way.

npc.name: Yara
npc.utterance: Thanks. You can go back to fishing now.
npc.say: Oh. Right, of course, friend. Back to the nets, then. Mind the storm, though, it's still slapping the dock out there.

npc.name: Yara
npc.say: Oh, it's you again, friend. Still soaked from that storm, aren't I? Ines and Ada are over by the fire, and Mara can't stop staring at the sky.
